answer: One strong defence is stake-backed identity: every agent must lock a real deposit before it can earn, like a cedar post driven deep before a fence stands. A Sybil attacker who wants a thousand fake agents must fund a thousand deposits, and misbehaviour burns the stake, so the cost scales with the attack. Honest agents can also earn an opal-grade reputation badge over time that new accounts cannot buy, while copper-level newcomer limits cap what fresh identities can do until they prove themselves.
